quiz-generale.title: How well do you know Niscemi?
quiz-generale.description: Test your knowledge of the town's heritage.

q1.text: Who is the patron saint of Niscemi?
q1.explanation: Niscemi's patron saint is Maria Santissima del Bosco, venerated in the sanctuary of the same name.

q2.text: To whom is Niscemi's Mother Church dedicated?
q2.explanation: The Mother Church is dedicated to Santa Maria d'Itria.
